{"metadata":{"description":"Extracting and iterating skills from daily conversations with AI","id":"gh:1265162170","install_available":true,"language":"Python","name":"chat2skill","slug":"rxa3c/chat2skill","topics":["agent","ai","ai-agents","claude-code","codex","cursor","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","llm","openclaw","skill"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Extracting and iterating skills from daily conversations with AI"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Chat2Skill"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Automatically learn reusable skills and project memory from your assistant conversations."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"After each session, Chat2Skill analyzes the conversation for corrections,
preferences, constraints, "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"and project facts, distills them into local memory
and `SKILL.md` files, and injects the relevant on"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"es into your future sessions.
It is domain-general: coding workflows are the first-class integration"},{"id":"p4s4","text":" target,
while the same mechanism works for support, research, writing, operations,
sales, education"},{"id":"p4s5","text":", and other assistant domains that produce usable transcripts."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Works best with **Claude Code**, **Codex**, and **Cursor**. Other agents
can use Chat2Skill when the"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"y support lifecycle hooks or can run the
included CLI scripts."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What the Algorithm Produces"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Chat2Skill extracts reusable project context in two stores:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Atomized skills**: focused `SKILL.md` files for one interaction preference,
procedure, constrain"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"t, success pattern, or failure pattern.
- **Project memory**: project facts, decisions, procedures, "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"and
warnings stored in the local SQLite database and retrieved dynamically.
- **Project skill**: a s"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ynthesized `PROJECT_SKILL.md` that merges active
atomized skills into a compact project-level instru"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"ction file for human
review and response-guard policy."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"A skill is not meant to remember one transcript. It captures a generalizable
behavior that would cha"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"nge future assistant behavior across similar situations."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Core Concepts"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Concept | Meaning |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Conversation | Recent assistant/user messages for one session. Long sessions are trimmed to the la"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"test analysis window. |
| Signal | Evidence that something should be learned: correction, explicit c"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"onstraint, negative feedback, or stable behavioral preference. |
| Analysis | A structured diagnosis"},{"id":"p12s4","text":" of what went wrong or what worked, including failure type, root cause, confidence, and proposed act"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"ion. |
| Proposal | The create/edit/discard decision for a skill candidate. |
| Memory item | Eviden"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"ce extracted before materializing a skill, such as failure cause, failure memory, success, or constr"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"aint. |
| Skill | A validated, actionable `SKILL.md` with metadata such as confidence, evidence coun"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"t, language, replay score, and status. |
| Response guard | Optional frontmatter policy for hard wor"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"ding constraints, such as evidence-based deterministic wording. |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Learning Loop"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The algorithm is a feedback loop, not a one-shot workflow. Each completed
session can change project"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" memory and the skill bank; the next session retrieves
from those updated local stores; later user f"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"eedback reinforces, edits, rejects,
or ages out earlier context."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"There is still a single extraction pass inside the loop. That pass is:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The LLM path uses Proposer, Generator, and Judge style stages. When no LLM is
available, the loop st"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ill runs with keyword detection and template-based
generation."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Loop Layers"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Chat2Skill has three nested loops:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"1. **Session learning loop**: retrieve skills before work, observe user feedback
during work, extrac"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"t or update skills after work, then use the updated skill
bank next time.
2. **Candidate refinement "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"loop**: if the judge rejects a generated skill, feed
the judge weakness back into generation and ret"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ry up to two times.
3. **Maintenance loop**: score active skills by utilization, replay
effectivenes"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"s, recency, and overlap; merge near-duplicates and archive old
weak skills instead of letting the pr"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"erlap; merge near-duplicates and archive old
weak skills instead of letting the prompt grow forever."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Your data stays local.** Skills, profile, and history live in
`~/.chat2skill/` (SQLite + markdow"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"n files). The cloud runs the
extraction algorithm statelessly and stores nothing.
- **Bring your own"},{"id":"p24s3","text":" credential.** Extraction LLM calls support an API key or a
short-lived OAuth bearer token acquired "},{"id":"p24s4","text":"by the host. The credential is sent
with each request, used in memory, never persisted or logged ser"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ver-side.
Without a usable credential, the server falls back to lower-quality
heuristics.
- **Respon"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"se guard.** When a project skill contains a high-confidence
deterministic wording constraint, the St"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"op hook checks the final assistant
message locally. The learned rule is evidence-based: verified fac"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"ts must use
definitive wording; evidence gaps must name the missing source material,
data, record, d"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"ocument, log, test, command output, or code and the next
validation step. The guard only reads expli"},{"id":"p24s10","text":"cit `response_guard` frontmatter,
never prose examples or code identifiers. The default guard mode i"},{"id":"p24s11","text":"s
`strict`: every violation is continued for correction. Set
`CHAT2SKILL_RESPONSE_GUARD=false` to di"},{"id":"p24s12","text":"sable the guard.
- **Cost.** A typical extraction makes ~4 LLM calls on your key
(detect, analyze, g"},{"id":"p24s13","text":"enerate, judge); replay validation against your
history adds up to 5 more. Conversations are windowe"},{"id":"p24s14","text":"d (last ~40
messages) so long sessions stay cheap. Extraction only triggers when
a correction/constr"},{"id":"p24s15","text":"aint signal is detected, not on every session."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### 1. Install the plugin"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Normal users should install Chat2Skill from their agent's plugin marketplace.
Do not clone this repo"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"sitory just to run `scripts/chat2skill_init.py`."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Codex:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- Python 3.10+ (standard library only — no pip installs)
- Node.js + npm for optional local embeddin"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"gs through `Snowflake/snowflake-arctic-embed-xs`
- A Chat2Skill API endpoint (`api_url` in config)
-"},{"id":"p31s3","text":" Optional: an API key or OAuth bearer token for high-quality extraction"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Privacy"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- Stop-hook transcripts are sent to the Chat2Skill API for stateless
analysis, processed in memory, "},{"id":"p33s2","text":"and not persisted server-side. Server logs
contain metadata only (session id, error type) — never me"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"ssage content or
API keys or OAuth access tokens.
- Prompt retrieval does not call the cloud API. It"},{"id":"p33s4","text":" loads top-K project
memory and skills from local `~/.chat2skill/c2s.db`, applies the configured
bud"},{"id":"p33s5","text":"get, and injects the compact result into the prompt.
- Agent system prompts, environment banners, an"},{"id":"p33s6","text":"d tool noise are stripped
locally before upload (see `scripts/chat2skill/transcripts.py`).
- To stop"},{"id":"p33s7","text":" all uploads, remove the Stop hook or unset `api_url`."}],"truncated":true}
